source_note: Weierstrass逼近定理的概率途径证明
english_source_note: A Probabilistic Proof of the Weierstrass Approximation Theorem
callout_id: Weierstrass逼近定理的概率途径证明#1
statement_en: Every $f\in C([0,1]\to \mathbb{R})$ can be uniformly approximated by real-coefficient polynomials that are also defined on $[0,1]$.
callout_body: $f\in C([0,1]\to \mathbb{R})$可以被同样定义在$[0,1]$上的实系数多项式一致逼近。
